ideas.pitch: An AI agent that automatically generates comprehensive API documentation, sequence diagrams, and integration test suites directly from your codebase git diffs upon every pull request.
ideas.title: Eclipse-AutoDoc
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses documentation debt which is a massive pain point for judges and developers alike, and features a functional git-hook automation pipeline that demos instantly.

ideas.pitch: A natural language to enterprise SQL and NoSQL query engine with schema auto-introspection, designed for non-technical operations teams.
ideas.title: QueryGenie
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors enterprise utility wins like Semantic Kernel plugins, making it immediately appealing to business-oriented hackathon judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: An automation agent that ingests raw customer support tickets, clusters them using semantic embeddings, and automatically drafts formatted GitHub issues with proposed code patch files.
ideas.title: AutoSprint-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines ticket classification and automated code generation into a polished end-to-end workflow that guarantees a high-impact live demo.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, training-free semantic router that dynamically directs user queries to the cheapest and most accurate local or cloud LLM based on task complexity.
ideas.title: SmartRoute LLM Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles cost-efficiency and performance routing—a technically sophisticated engineering feat that stands out in pure AI-focused hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated GitHub Actions troubleshooting bot that reads failing build logs, analyzes stack traces, generates fix patches, and pushes automated corrective pull requests.
ideas.title: CI-Healer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent everyday pain point for developers with a concrete, hands-on automation workflow that is easy to record and demonstrate live.
